quests.title: Sightseeing With Friends: Back to Sumeru

dialogue.t: Feast your eyes on the Palace of Alcazarzaray — pretty plants as far as the eye can see!
Paimon actually noticed how beautiful it was here earlier in our travels! But our Fungi friends probably haven't had a chance to really look around yet, huh?

dialogue.sit: Yeah, this is definitely right up their alley.

dialogue.t: Okay, it's time to check out some landscape paintings that best capture Sumeru's unique essence! Bongo-Head, Kindlejoy, come take a look and compare them!

quests.description: After traveling for some time, Paimon has a new plan…
